body.statement:
Fix \(\mathfrak m\in\mathfrak M_{n,K,d,	au}\) with \(\Delta=V\). For distinct \(a,b\in V\) and \(C\subseteq V\setminus\{a,b\}\), the complete oracle is determined by \(\{D_I(v):v\in I\}\): if \(a,b
otin I\), then \(a\) and \(b\) are d-connected given \(\overline C\); if \(a\in I\) and \(b
otin I\), they are d-connected given \(\overline C\) iff \(D_I(a)\cap(\{b\}\cup C)
e\varnothing\); and if \(a,b\in I\), they are d-connected given \(\overline C\) iff both \(D_I(a)\cap C
e\varnothing\) and \(D_I(b)\cap C
e\varnothing\).
body.justification: This compresses every full conditional-independence answer on the hard subclass to surviving component-descendant sets, making legal transcript lower bounds tractable.
body.gap: VariciKatzWeiSattigeriTajer2024Interventional uses local marginal descendant tests; it does not state the complete conditional-separation oracle equivalence for arbitrary conditioning sets.
body.consumer: The lower-bound solver can certify equality of entire adaptive transcripts by comparing descendant signatures instead of enumerating all barred-copy paths.
